title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11476)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard defines the various terms used, concerning oils and fats and their industrial products. Some of the analytical terms commonly used in the specifications have also been included.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Glossary of Terms Relating to Bakery Industry

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
